crossRefs.note: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms…
Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble…
“Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh…
Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but…
They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout…
Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish…
As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the…
the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of…
Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Return from me. That which…
So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from…
Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion…
Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

people.name: Azekah
people.line: Judean town, site of battles and sieges.

people.name: Jerusalem

translations.web: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.
translations.bsb: as the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the remaining cities of Judah—against Lachish and Azekah. For these were the only fortified cities remaining in Judah.
translations.kjv: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
translations.asv: when the king of Babylon's army was fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.
